title: Interview with Kira
summary: Lena interviewed Kira, an architect, in a newsroom interview.

qa_highlights.question: What role does the community play?
qa_highlights.answer: Volunteers found most of the bugs

qa_highlights.question: How did people react when it came out?
qa_highlights.answer: Mostly curiosity, and some critics said the method was too slow

qa_highlights.question: Who influenced you the most?
qa_highlights.answer: Their first supervisor, who asked better questions instead of giving answers

qa_highlights.question: How did you pay for the first year?
qa_highlights.answer: A small grant covered the equipment and weekend consulting paid for the rest

quotes.speaker: Kira
quotes.text: Without them we would still be guessing.

quotes.speaker: Kira
quotes.text: She never gave answers, she only asked better questions.
